items.title: What is a dream?
items.explanation: A dream is a wish or hope that you have for the future. In the story, Jahnavi had a dream to learn to read like her friends Ettan and Meena.

items.title: How can a dream come true?
items.explanation: To make your dream come true, you must work hard, stay determined, and try your best even when others say it is too late or impossible.
